author: olpipi
title: Android workflow build fails - first attempt failure logs unavailable, second attempt auto-started
signature: android workflow build step failure logs unavailable|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: Build arm64
failed_jobs.symptom: First attempt failed with no accessible logs; second attempt (run_attempt=2) auto-started and is in progress

key_errors: No failed job logs captured from run attempt 1
run_attempt: 2 indicates attempt 1 failed before logs were collected
Build arm64 job on attempt 2 was in_progress at investigation time
root_cause: The Android workflow's first run attempt failed before job logs could be captured, which is a hallmark of transient runner infrastructure issues (e.g., runner startup failure, Docker pull timeout, resource exhaustion). The CI system automatically re-ran the failed jobs (run_attempt=2), which reached the 'CMake - build OpenVINO' step before this investigation ran. The PR itself (revert of allocator fix) changes only src/core/src/runtime/allocator.cpp and a test file — neither of which should affect Android compilation. The failure is almost certainly unrelated to the PR code changes.
reproduction_steps: N/A - infrastructure transient failure not reproducible locally
recommended_actions: Wait for run_attempt 2 to complete — if it succeeds, the original failure was transient
If attempt 2 also fails, look for Android-specific CMake or link errors in the logs
No code changes needed if attempt 2 passes
prevention_strategies: Transient runner failures are infrastructure-level and cannot be fully prevented. The automatic retry mechanism (run_attempt=2) already handles this scenario.
historical_context: A similar pattern was observed for RISC-V builds (pattern eb524e8027ac9d8f). Android CMake configure has also been a recurring issue (pattern 9ff022172665aa06, 20 occurrences) but that pattern involves MODULE_LIBRARY linking errors, which would produce log evidence — not the same issue.
